preconditions.description: The number of words N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(length) <= 1000 for length in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each word length is a natural number not exceeding 1000.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the first line is 'YES', there are exactly N more lines, each containing one word.
If the first line is 'NO', there are no more lines.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' and all(len(word) == int(length) for word, length in zip(stdout.split()[1:], stdin.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each output word has the corresponding length specified in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' and all(set(word) <= {'0', '1'} for word in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each output word consists only of the letters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' and all(not any(word.startswith(prefix) for i, prefix in enumerate(stdout.split()[1:]) if i != j) for j, word in enumerate(stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: No word is a prefix of another word.
